pass: Pass 32 - Classic SET Profile / Communication Settings

policy.pass: Only exact retained native command/value/toggle semantics are promoted.
policy.strong: Existing runtime behavior may remain active when strongly evidenced but not exact.
policy.unknown: Defaults, persistence ownership, event/message classification and conflicting polarity remain evidence-gated.

claims: SET MESSAGES accepts Low/Medium/High.
SET FOLLOW accepts Blind/Normal; Blind reduces messages while following in a party.
SET ENTRANCES accepts On/Off and controls notices when adventurers enter or leave The Realm.
SET SPEECH accepts Fast/Slow; Slow requires the configured speech character and Fast treats non-command/action text as room speech.
SET TELEPATH On/Off exists, but its compact wording does not safely prove the stored blocking/receipt polarity.
SET RECEIVE wording conflicts another retained Profile help record and is not newly promoted by this pass.
SET FOLLOW (Blind/Normal) is native.
SET ENTRANCES (On/Off) is native.
Bare SET SPEECH toggles fast and slow talking.
Low shows high-priority messages only.
Medium shows high- and medium-priority messages.
High shows high-, medium-, and low-priority messages.
The native help explicitly declines to enumerate every message priority classification, so per-message classification remains unresolved.
GOSSIP with no message toggles receipt.
SET GOSSIP with no value toggles receipt.
SET GOSSIP ON and SET GOSSIP OFF explicitly enable/disable receipt.
AUCTION with no message toggles receipt.
SET AUCTION with no value toggles receipt.
SET AUCTION ON and SET AUCTION OFF explicitly enable/disable receipt.
Profile help independently documents Talk Fast/Slow and Set Receive.
Set Receive wording conflicts SET help polarity, so this pass does not promote explicit RECEIVE polarity further.

runtimeCorrections: Bare SET FOLLOW now toggles Normal/Blind instead of merely reporting the current value.
SET SPEECH now has a dedicated wrapper so bare SET SPEECH toggles Fast/Slow while bare TALK remains invalid and does not silently toggle.
SET MESSAGES LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH now persists the explicitly selected native level; no native default is invented.
SET ENTRANCES [ON|OFF] plus bare toggle now persists an explicitly selected state; no native default or exact entrance notification rendering is invented.
Existing GOSSIP/AUCTION bare-toggle and explicit ON/OFF behavior is retained and promoted narrowly.
remainingUnknown: Native defaults and exact persistence owner/serialization for communication/profile settings.
Conflicting SET RECEIVE polarity wording between retained help records.
Exact per-message priority classification and complete runtime filtering for SET MESSAGES.
Exact login/logout/realm entrance event rendering, recipient timing and default for SET ENTRANCES.
MAXPAGES/flood/page behavior, SET INTERRUPT execution, SET WARNING execution and remaining exact channel rendering.
Native FAST-mode resolver remains distinct from the operator-mandated Reforged command-to-SAY fallback that applies globally.
